q: How do I pay my fees online?
reply: Log in to the student portal, open 'Fees > Pay Online', select the instalment and pay using UPI, net banking, debit/credit card. Download the receipt after the payment is confirmed.
The library is open from 8:30 AM to 8:00 PM on weekdays and 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM on Saturdays. During exams, the reading hall may stay open late; notices are put on the library door and portal.

q: Where can I download my hall ticket?
reply: After filling the exam form and clearing dues, the hall ticket is available on the examination portal under 'Admit Card'. Carry a printed copy and your ID card to the exam hall.
